title: Chuck Clark's road-trip tape of a wobbling orange disc
summary: James Fox tells of Chuck Clark's road-trip tape of a wobbling orange disc, about 1995 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and then the next thing you see is a orange disc shaped thing just wobbling
So, this footage, supposedly authentic, was taken by two college kids who wanted to go to Area 51 in the '90s. I believe it was 1995
tellings.difference: Says two college kids shot it and places it at the black mailbox, where the story credits Chuck Clark and places it at Rachel.
tellings.link_reason: The same 1995 tape of a wobbling orange disc filmed near Area 51 on a road trip.

as_told.title: 1995 black mailbox footage of an orange wobbling disc
